title: Version history
intro: Every save creates a version. Restoring an older version saves it as a new version; no version gets lost. Undo/redo in the editor is not affected.
noteHint: Saves the current changes as a new version with this description.
empty: No versions yet. The first one is created on the next save.
sameAsEditor: Same as the state in the editor.
restoreText: The workflow is set back to version {{number}} and saved as a new version. All earlier versions are kept.
restoreDirty: Unsaved changes in the editor get lost. Save them as a version first if you want to keep them.
